en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a panoramic view of a city with a prominent hill or small mountain at the center, topped with trees and possible ruins or fortifications. Surrounding the hill are scattered houses and a river, with the city sprawling in the background. There is a stamp in the upper left corner, and Greek, French, and Latin-alphabet text at the bottom.
